_comment: Cleavage presets of digest.enzyme, in the residue-pair rule syntax of DIA-NN --cut: comma-separated pairs (residue before the cut, residue after it), '*' = any residue, a leading '!' = never cut there. A bond is cut when a positive pair matches and no '!' pair does. Read by the engine (mumdia-core/src/cleavage.rs) and the desktop application (desktop/src-tauri/src/enzymes.rs); both are tested against 'test_vectors'. Standard specificities from the literature; a variant is a 'custom' rule.

trypsin_p.label: Trypsin/P
trypsin_p.note: after K or R, also before P

trypsin.label: Trypsin
trypsin.note: after K or R, not before P

glu_c.label: Glu-C
glu_c.note: after E (bicarbonate buffer; 'E*,D*' as a custom rule for phosphate buffer)

chymotrypsin.label: Chymotrypsin
chymotrypsin.note: after F, Y or W, not before P (high specificity)

non_specific.label: Non-specific
non_specific.note: every peptide bond; peptides by length, missed cleavages do not apply
